v3_plan_summary: The 2026-06-17 v3.0.0 plan (206 tasks, PH-001-006, 166 done) covers ToolSpec CLI-SSOT registry and zero-drift, A1 contradiction cache, A3 blast-radius, steps/deferred-merge, work modes/vibe trace, granular edit/retarget/search, sync-counts, environment doctor, and diagnostics remediation with grouped validate UX. The kiwi workflow-artifact/JSONL/work-order/lock/collision-repair track is excluded, planned separately in the 2026-06-29 v2.3.0 plan.
caveat_from_main_session: 본 인벤토리의 already_planned_in_v3 분류는 2026-06-17 v3 plan 기준. 이 중 다수(artifact resolver, JSONL core, work-order, lock, collision repair 등)는 2026-06-29 v2.3.0 plan으로 이미 구현·verified 되었으므로 'v2.3.0에서 해소된 갭'과 '잔존 갭'을 Synthesizer가 아닌 Opus A 최종 산출물 기준으로 재확인 필요.
